title: Hacktoberfest chat gets images and streaming
summary:
Chat got images and streaming, subscriptions got clearer, and the API’s citations, image stats, and proxy plumbing got attention.

CloudCompile’s React chat app now accepts pasted and dropped images, lets people search models, and shows replies as they stream in. The updates also improve mobile interactions and preserve indentation in responses.

Enter’s tier panel now distinguishes active, canceled, and absent subscriptions, shows cancellation end dates, and displays activation failures inline. Separate work prepared production billing configuration and migration tooling; it does not establish that customer data or subscriptions have moved.

Chat responses now preserve citation URLs from Perplexity models. The image service also gained `/model-stats`, which reports request counts by model; subsequent work made those counts persist across server restarts.

daily.title: Images in Hacktoberfest chat
daily.text: Paste or drop an image into the React chat app to send it with your message. Model search makes switching models easier, too.

daily.title: Streaming chat replies
daily.text: The Hacktoberfest chat app now displays replies as chunks arrive instead of waiting for the whole response.

daily.title: Image model usage counts
daily.text: Query `/model-stats` on the image service for request counts by model. Counts now persist across server restarts.
